inputs.modified_text: Get a load of this. An Indiana judge blocked a prolife law earlier this month by claiming limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice pushed the line that the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” This is nothing but coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, who are using the courts to pervert religious freedom as a means to keep abortion available. They're flipping the narrative around to stop any true protections for life, and these so-called sincerely held beliefs are merely a disguise for their real plan to hold onto power using outfits like these. The connections are everywhere, and they're not covering their tracks as effectively as they believe.
